claims.author: BarneyChambers
claims.harm: signrawtransactionwithwallet prematurely reports complete=true on incomplete spends with dummy member witnesses because per-input script verification succeeds on markers
claims.quote: ProduceSignature and DataFromTransaction then treat that success as complete, so a dummy member looks fully signed.

status_by.quote: SignTransaction now runs VerifyCISATransaction once all inputs are processed and reports the error on the aggregated inp

claims.status_note: author added tx-level VerifyCISATransaction check in SignTransaction and a wallet test

claims.author: BarneyChambers
claims.harm: combinepsbt silently keeps the first half-aggregation signature instead of detecting conflicting signatures across inputs
claims.quote: Half-agg signatures do not get checked the same way. Merge keeps the first m_cisa_halfagg_sig it sees.

status_by.quote: This is intended, halfagg has no signing session so two different signatures for the same input can both be valid and ei

claims.status_note: author explained keeping first is intended per BIP 174/371 and added test showing invalid sigs fail finalization

claims.author: BarneyChambers
claims.harm: FinalizeCISAInputs skipping already-signed inputs can partition inputs into duplicate groups of the same mode that fail consensus
claims.quote: This skip on already-signed inputs can leave you with two separate groups of the same mode. Consensus then fails the tx with SCRIPT_ERR_CISA_GROUP_INVALID

status_by.quote: The finalizer should treat a group as closed once any input of that mode has a final witness and I have changed Finalize

claims.status_note: author updated FinalizeCISAInputs to close group once an input has a final witness
